Spell Check is Global

Spell check went from a two-hundred-dollar standalone luxury to a free global reflex once local compute cost hit near zero.

[$200 Standalone Box -> $0 Feature for 7B+ People]

1/3 People once paid hundreds of dollars for standalone spell check, yet today it comes free inside every phone and browser.

2/3 Spell check became free because checking a word costs almost nothing to run right inside the writing tool you own.

3/3 Other forms of computer intelligence will reach seven billion people only when they run cheaply on everyday local devices.
